data:
Decision: CONDITIONAL GO. Win probability: 98.4%.

Top probability drivers: (1) Strong expected evaluation score estimate (71.4) is the dominant positive driver. (2) Minimal administrative burden (only 3 tender pages) slightly improves execution certainty and reduces bid error risk. (3) Only one compliance gap overall (21 PASS, 5 PARTIAL, 1 GAP) keeps eligibility risk low; response time and 87% compliance coverage have negligible negative impact.

Mandatory gaps and what closing them takes: Eligibility gap—must evidence at least three web/software development projects in the last five years, each ≥ PKR 5M. To close: identify qualifying references, compile completion certificates/POs/invoices and client contact details, and align each to scope (website/portal/software dev) and value threshold; if short, secure a compliant consortium/subcontractor with transferable experience and include formal JV/teaming documentation.

Recommendation: Proceed only if we can document three ≥ PKR 5M projects (or partner to satisfy it); otherwise NO-GO.
